reading: core: the product line Order management, 'Manage orders from every channel in a single location' (BC-S-0105); BigCommerce's own Orders V2 API, 'Manage order coupons, messages, products, shipping addresses, statuses, taxes, shipments, and shipping address quotes' (BC-S-0103), Order Operations, which 'configure order settings' among others (BC-S-0104), and Storefront Orders (BC-I-0011); the access scope store_v2_orders (BC-S-0106); the webhook topics store/order/created (BC-S-0107) and store/order/archived (BC-I-0166; what archiving does isn't stated). extension-point: the App Marketplace category Catalog & Order Management (BC-I-0480), also cited in B's CM-CAT-001 and F's CM-APP-002. core: the Orders V2 API manages an order's 'products, shipping addresses' (BC-S-0103), and the access scope store_v2_orders, 'View and modify orders' (BC-S-0106).
